title: Evaluating medical AI systems in dermatology under uncertain ground truth
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of medical AI systems for accuracy and uncertainty in diagnostic decisions, especially regarding risk categories. While medical applications have inherent ethical implications (e.g., patient safety), the paper's core contribution is not to evaluate or benchmark ethical frameworks, moral reasoning, or faith components within AI/LLMs. It does not contain dedicated sections for such evaluations as a primary focus.
